teams.heading: Lewis Moody reveals wife Annie's promise to stay with him through MND
teams.body: Moody told the High Performance podcast that his wife Annie has insisted she will stay present when he can no longer speak or move. "She said she’d be there no matter what," he said. The former flanker, who revealed his diagnosis last year after noticing weakness in his shoulder during a gym session, also described the pain of telling his sons Dylan and Ethan. He says he is "at peace" with the condition, while acknowledging there is no known cure.

lead.why: It is the only NEW item with concrete, on-the-record detail, and the Dallaglio story is excluded as already reported.

teams.heading: Femi-CZ Rovigo clinch Coppa Italia semi-final place with 47-15 win at Vicenza
teams.body: Rovigo's fourth-round trip to Vicenza ended in a bonus-point 47-15 win over Rangers, and that result settled their semi-final place. It also takes them top of Girone 1 on 20 points, five clear of Rangers in second on 15. The race for the second semi-final berth is wide open, with Parabiago on 12 and Mogliano on 10 still in contention, and the fifth and final round will decide it.

teams.heading: WRU explores two Welsh clubs in Gallagher Prem despite cutting to three
teams.body: The WRU has told the Professional Rugby Board it is exploring the possibility of two Welsh clubs playing in the Gallagher Prem, a development that complicates a plan already under fire. Directors voted unanimously to cut the four professional teams to three, with one licence each in the east, centre and west, and Ospreys and Scarlets competing for the western slot unless they merge. A summit with the four clubs is expected in December, and the union is due to confirm the three licensed teams by next March.

lead.why: A fresh WRU development with concrete facts, and it bears directly on Wales's professional structure, unlike the already-reported Hawkins and Adams items.

teams.heading: Ireland's Sam Prendergast edging back for Pumas after wrist injury, O'Connell says
teams.body: Sam Prendergast is winning his race for fitness ahead of Friday's game against the Pumas. He picked up a wrist injury in a Leinster-Munster interpro last month, but assistant coach Paul O'Connell says the 23-year-old has stepped up training, jumping in and out of non-contact sessions and bits close to full-contact. "I'm not 100% sure, but he looks like he could be OK." Prendergast appears to be the only injury concern for Irish management, with Jimmy O'Brien back in full training after a concussion.

teams.heading: Scott Barrett moves on from losing All Blacks captaincy to Ardie Savea
teams.body: Scott Barrett has reflected on the change, pointing to Kane Williamson, the former Black Caps captain who let go of the role and kept playing. Dave Rennie, who handed the leadership to Ardie Savea when he took over, has described Barrett as "a bit of a reluctant captain". Barrett missed the whole Super Rugby Pacific season through injury and was back for the Bledisloe Cup Tests before being named in the touring squad for the November leg of the Nations Championship.
